Job Description: 
 
 
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day. 

 Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits. 

 We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve. Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs. 

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
 


 Position Summary 

 CTI ADS API Services team is seeking a highly motivated Infrastructure Developer with 5 to 7 years of experience to join the API Services Platform Engineering team.

 The API Services Platform team designs, builds, automates, and supports large-scale middleware and API infrastructure across globally distributed environments. The Infrastructure Developer will play a key role in modernizing the platform and helping API Services implement the Project Helm vision of increasingly automated, machine-speed vulnerability remediation .
 The engineer will design and develop infrastructure automation across Linux, AWS, Azure, containers, middleware platforms, and DevOps pipelines . A major focus will be eliminating repetitive manual activities through Ansible, Python, Shell scripting, APIs, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code.
 


 The position will develop reusable automation for: 
 Vulnerability identification and inventory analysis
 Mapping vulnerabilities to affected infrastructure
 Automated infrastructure and middleware patching
 Software installation and upgrades
 Configuration management
 EOL technology remediation
 Container image and runtime remediation
 Automated pre-deployment and post-deployment validation
 Infrastructure health checks
 Configuration and compliance validation
 Automated rollback and recovery
 Evidence generation and remediation reporting
 
 The engineer will work closely with Platform Engineering, Cybersecurity, Cloud, SRE, DevOps, Application Development, and Production Support teams to move remediation workflows from manual, human-speed processes toward automated, machine-speed execution .

 Primary Skills 
 Linux / Unix Infrastructure Engineering 
 Ansible / Infrastructure Automation 
 Python and Shell Scripting 
 AWS and Microsoft Azure 
 DevOps / CI/CD 
 Containers / Kubernetes 
 Infrastructure as Code 
 Security Vulnerability Remediation 
 Middleware / API Platform Infrastructure
 Monitoring and Observability
 
 Required Skills 
 5 to 7 years of hands-on experience in Infrastructure Engineering, Platform Engineering, DevOps, SRE, or a similar engineering role.
 Strong hands-on experience with Linux / Unix , including system configuration, troubleshooting, networking, storage, process management, security, patching, and performance analysis.
 Strong experience with Ansible , including playbooks, roles, inventories, templates, reusable automation modules, and configuration management.
 Strong scripting and development skills using Python and Bash/Shell . PowerShell experience is beneficial.
 Experience developing automation rather than relying primarily on manual infrastructure administration.
 Hands-on experience with AWS and/or Microsoft Azure , including compute, networking, storage, IAM, load balancing, monitoring, and security.
 Experience with Docker/OCI containers and containerized application or middleware environments.
 Experience with Kubernetes and/or OpenShift is highly desirable.
 Experience with CI/CD and DevOps tooling , including Jenkins, Git, Ansible Automation Platform/Tower, or comparable enterprise tooling.
 Experience with Infrastructure as Code , preferably Terraform or comparable technologies.
 Experience automating server builds, software installation, middleware configuration, patching, upgrades, security remediation, health checks, and validation .
 Experience supporting vulnerability-management and remediation programs, including CVE assessment, patch deployment, configuration changes, technology currency, and EOL remediation .
 Ability to build automated solutions that determine infrastructure state and execute remediation consistently across large numbers of systems.
 Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, SSL/TLS, certificates, load balancers, proxies, firewalls, identity/access management, and secrets management .
 Experience using APIs to integrate infrastructure, DevOps, monitoring, vulnerability-management, and configuration-management platforms.
 Experience supporting highly available, business-critical production platforms in a large enterprise environment.
 Experience with monitoring, logging, and observability solutions such as Splunk and Dynatrace .
 Understanding of REST APIs, API gateways, middleware, microservices, and distributed systems.
 Strong troubleshooting and root-cause-analysis capabilities spanning OS, network, container, middleware, application, and cloud layers .
 Experience with Agile/SDLC practices and supporting tools such as Jira, Git, and Confluence.
 Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work across globally distributed engineering and cybersecurity teams.
 
 Key Project Helm Responsibilities 
 The successful candidate will be expected to contribute directly to API Services' implementation of the Project Helm strategy, including:
 Automated Discovery 
Develop automation to continuously identify vulnerable infrastructure, software versions, middleware components, dependencies, and container images.
 Impact Determination 
Automate correlation of vulnerabilities with affected servers, runtimes, environments, applications, and platform components.
 Automated Remediation 
Develop Ansible, Python, Shell, CI/CD, and Infrastructure-as-Code solutions capable of executing remediation at scale.
 Automated Testing and Validation 
Build pre-checks, post-checks, smoke tests, health checks, and validation routines that demonstrate that remediation was successful without introducing platform instability.
 Safe Deployment at Scale 
Support progressive deployment patterns, automated rollback, exception handling, and risk-based remediation across large infrastructure estates.
 Reduce Human Intervention 
Identify manual operational processes and systematically convert them into reusable automation that contributes toward Project Helm's long-term automated-remediation objective. 
 
 Desired Skills 
 Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL)
 Ansible Automation Platform / Ansible Tower
 AWS and/or Azure certification
 Kubernetes / OpenShift
 Terraform
 Docker / OCI container platforms
 Python automation development
 Bash / Shell scripting
 PowerShell
 Jenkins pipeline development
 Git / Bitbucket
 Splunk
 Dynatrace
 Maven
 REST API automation
 Security vulnerability management
 Automated patch management
 Automated testing and validation
 SRE / platform resiliency engineering
 Experience supporting MuleSoft, TIBCO, API gateways, or enterprise middleware 
 Experience automating remediation across large distributed infrastructure estates
 
 
 
 Shift: 
1st shift (United States of America) 
 
 Hours Per Week:  
40 
 
 Pay Transparency details 
 
 
US - NJ - Jersey City - 101 Hudson St - 101 Hudson (NJ2101) 
 
Pay and benefits information 
 
Pay range 
 
$81,200.00 - $134,300.00 annualized salary, offers to be determined based on experience, education and skill set. 
 
Discretionary incentive eligible 
 
This role is eligible to participate in the annual discretionary plan. Employees are eligible for an annual discretionary award based on their overall individual performance results and behaviors, the performance and contributions of their line of business and/or group; and the overall success of the Company. 
 
Benefits 
 
This role is currently benefits eligible. We provide industry-leading benefits, access to paid time off, resources and support to our employees so they can make a genuine impact and contribute to the sustainable growth of our business and the communities we serve.
